svg.title: AWS Cloud Serverless Architecture
svg.desc: Admin Vanilla Publishing delivery path using CloudFront, S3, API Gateway, Lambda, a data store, and an optional EKS steering plane.
svg.text: Static delivery uses CloudFront + S3. API traffic flows through API Gateway into a Lambda-hosted FastAPI runtime.

g.text: Browser access from office or VPN
Single public edge entry for the web app
Caches static files and forwards API routes
Static origin for files synced from public/
Frontend bundle, images, and docs assets
Public HTTPS API surface for auth and app APIs
Aurora or RDS when persistent storage is needed
Can also point to an external database
The optional EKS plane is separate from the request path and is provisioned with the scripts under scripts/aws/ and infra/aws/steering.
Steering cluster for ops policies and add-ons
